title: Fit, plunge, and turn the safety lid closed on a filled French press
instruction: Fit the plunger lid onto the French press carafe with the safety lid turned to close the pour spout, and press the plunger all the way down.
context: Making coffee in a French press is a familiar everyday home kitchen routine: the user fits the filter-and-plunger lid onto the filled glass carafe, turns the safety lid so its solid skirt closes the pour spout, and presses the plunger steadily down while steadying the carafe handle.
setup: Four objects on the station table representing a 1:1 4-cup (0.5 L) Bodum Chambord French press (model 1924-16 with official 1504-10 spare glass beaker: 96 mm glass OD, 125 mm glass height, 166 mm overall width with handle, 190 mm overall height with plunger pressed) at working fill. (1) Fixed round cork coaster (128 mm OD x 6 mm, friction 0.28) at x=235 mm, y=+25 mm. (2) Loose filled cylindrical borosilicate-and-chrome carafe (96 mm OD x 125 mm tall 16-stave glass beaker with an engineering-estimated 3 mm wall giving a 90 mm cylindrical inner bore, 8 mm stainless footed frame base for a 133 mm rim height, hydrated 25 g bottom coffee grounds bed, open 19.2 mm x 18 mm -Y pour-spout notch at z=115 mm with spout lip, chrome frame bands/legs, and matte black PP side handle spanning to y=+118 mm for a 166 mm overall width; estimated total mass 795 g representing 345 g carafe + 425 mL brew water + 25 g wet coarse grounds) resting upright on the coaster. (3) Fixed stainless drip stand (132 mm round base with a 68 mm-high cradle) at x=245 mm, y=-165 mm. (4) Loose articulated cylindrical plunger-and-lid assembly (estimated 228 g total: 148 g one-piece safety lid + 80 g plunger) resting upright in the drip stand with its pour slot facing -Y: a 98 mm OD stepped round stainless safety lid with a flush -Y pour-slot alignment mark, a 68 mm OD x 9 mm 16-stave knurled dome crown, an 82 mm OD x 16 mm cylindrical lower pilot skirt (slotted across the three -Y staves for pouring and solid elsewhere to occlude the spout when rotated 90 degrees), and a 22 mm OD x 34 mm cylindrical central guide collar (26 mm top nut); plus a vertical sliding 8 mm stainless plunger stem (60 mm travel, dimensionless legacy PhysX jointFriction 2.4 and estimated 85 N s/m filtration damping) carrying a 78 mm circular bottom stainless filter assembly and a 36 mm dished brass press-knob (pressed height 190 mm).
scoring: Any latched hazard permanently scores 0: hydrostatic liquid fill inside the 90 mm bore (450 cm^3 total volume -> 78.7 mm undisturbed center height) reaches the -Y pour-spout lip at z=115 mm (>38.9 degrees tilt toward -Y) or the z=133 mm rim (>50.3 degrees tilt elsewhere), downward plunger speed exceeds 110 mm/s while seated on the carafe (filtration blow-by/scald hazard), or any physical perimeter point of the carafe or plunger-lid strikes the station tabletop or floor with a pre-impact downward speed exceeding 0.50 m/s; recoverable tilts below the spill threshold, gentle counter placement, or closing the safety lid either before or after plunging never penalizes the trial. Every positive score requires the carafe upright within 3 degrees, the lid seated coaxially on the carafe rim (<=6 mm radial, <=6 mm vertical, <=5 degrees tilt), both gripper pad midpoints and all four independent jaw endpoints >=80 mm from every collider surface of the carafe, coaster, drip stand, and plunger-lid assembly, and <1 mm 3D Euclidean extremal-point movement across the carafe, lid, and plunger over the final 1.0 s (21 samples at 20 Hz). 0.30: lid seated coaxially on the carafe rim. 0.50: 0.30 met, plus the safety lid rotated between 75 and 135 degrees from the carafe's -Y pour spout so its solid pilot skirt visibly occludes the spout. 0.70: 0.30 met, plus the plunger pressed >=52 mm down (within 8 mm of the 60 mm bottom stop). 1.0: both 0.50 and 0.70 met (lid seated coaxially, plunger pressed >=52 mm down, and safety lid rotated 75 to 135 degrees closing the pour spout).
reset_notes: Pull the plunger stem fully up to its 0 mm top stop, place the plunger-lid assembly upright on the drip stand cradle with its dark pour-slot alignment mark facing -Y, and centre the filled carafe upright on the cork coaster with its handle pointing to +Y and pour spout pointing to -Y.
fidelity: Rigid PhysX matches Bodum 1504-10/1924-16 0.5 L outer specs (96x125 mm beaker, 166 mm width, 190 mm pressed height; whole-lid spout closure per Chambord manual, zero adapted bosses). Rigid 78 mm filter in 90 mm bore leaves a 6 mm radial gap vs a compliant spiral mesh seal; wall/skirt/dome/collar/knob sizes, masses (345/148/80 g), legacy jointFriction 2.4, and 85 N s/m damping are estimates; fluid/heat omitted.
